An offline app for learning the flags, capitals and facts of the 196 countries of the world, and Antarctica.

Each country entry was researched against public sources, mostly Wikipedia, national constitutions and official sites, and then checked a second time by two independent reviewers who could only change a fact they could both source. Population figures are the United Nations World Population Prospects 2024 estimates, rounded to three significant figures; the other facts were checked in 2026. The research notes, the audit and the owner\'s decisions are in the repository, and a country\'s detail sheet lists the pages its facts were checked against.

The 196 sovereign states as widely recognised, plus Antarctica to browse. Flags are drawn to each country\'s own proportions. Where the meaning of a flag is disputed or legendary, the text says so instead of picking a side; a fact that could not be settled was left out rather than guessed.

The app has no network permission: nothing you do leaves the device, and there is no account. Your progress is stored in the app\'s own database and included in Android\'s backup of the app, so it moves with you to a new phone when backup is on. Settings > Reset progress deletes all of it.
